definitions.full: H8151. shanas [ שָׁנַס ] verb Pi`el gird up (si vera lectio; in Talmud (Aramaic) שְׁנַץ = bind sandals; Late Hebrew שֶׁנֶץ thong ); — Imperfect 3masculine singular וַיָּ֫רָץ מָתְנָיו וַיְשַׁנֵּס 1Kin 18:46 . שְׁנָת Psa 132:4 see שֵׁנָה .
